measures.Expression: SUM(FactDemand[ActualMW])
measures.Description: Sum of hourly mean MW multiplied by each one-hour interval.

measures.Expression: AVERAGE(FactDemand[ActualMW])
measures.Description: Mean hourly PJM balancing authority demand over the selected UTC dates.

measures.Expression: MAX(FactDemand[ActualMW])
measures.Description: Maximum observed hourly mean demand; not an instantaneous peak.

measures.Expression: COALESCE(COUNT(FactDemand[ActualMW]), 0)
measures.Description: Number of nonblank one-hour observations; zero when no observations exist. Missing demand is not counted as zero.

measures.Expression: COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FactDemand), 0)
measures.Description: Number of expected one-hour slots on the complete UTC grid; zero for an empty date selection.

measures.Expression: [Expected Hours] - [Observed Hours]
measures.Description: Expected hourly slots without a valid observed actual.

measures.Expression: DIVIDE([Observed Hours], [Expected Hours])
measures.Description: Observed valid hours divided by expected hourly slots.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), SELECTEDVALUE(DimModel[Model]), "Select one model to view forecast KPIs")
measures.Description: Model safeguard for cards and lines; comparison tables supply row context.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW]))), 0))
measures.Description: Scored 2025 hourly pairs for exactly one model; zero for an empty scored subset.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), SUMX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), FactForecast[ActualMW]))
measures.Description: Actual one-hour energy on scored test pairs; excludes future rows.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), SUMX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), FactForecast[ForecastMW]))
measures.Description: Forecast one-hour energy on the same scored test pairs.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), AVERAGEX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), FactForecast[ActualMW]))
measures.Description: Mean actual hourly demand MW, at the current axis grain, on scored test pairs.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), AVERAGEX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), FactForecast[ForecastMW]))
measures.Description: Mean forecast MW, at the current axis grain, on scored test pairs.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), AVERAGEX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), ABS(FactForecast[ForecastMW] - FactForecast[ActualMW])))
measures.Description: Mean absolute hourly error; lower is better.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), SQRT(AVERAGEX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), POWER(FactForecast[ForecastMW] - FactForecast[ActualMW], 2))))
measures.Description: Root mean squared hourly error, emphasizing large errors.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), DIVIDE(SUMX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), ABS(FactForecast[ForecastMW] - FactForecast[ActualMW])), SUMX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), ABS(FactForecast[ActualMW]))))
measures.Description: Ratio of aggregate absolute error to aggregate absolute actual demand. Never average daily WAPE.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), AVERAGEX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), FactForecast[ForecastMW] - FactForecast[ActualMW]))
measures.Description: Forecast minus actual; positive means overforecasting.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Lower80MW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Upper80MW]))), 0))
measures.Description: Number of scored test observations with both interval bounds; zero when none exist.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), DIVIDE(COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Lower80MW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Upper80MW])), FactForecast[ActualMW] >= FactForecast[Lower80MW] && FactForecast[ActualMW] <= FactForecast[Upper80MW])), 0), COUNTROWS(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Lower80MW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Upper80MW])))))
measures.Description: Observed empirical coverage of nominal 80% hourly prediction intervals. Zero when no actual is covered, blank when no interval pairs exist.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), AVERAGEX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Lower80MW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Upper80MW])), FactForecast[Upper80MW] - FactForecast[Lower80MW]))
measures.Description: Mean width on test rows with interval bounds.
Fixed 90th percentile of valid initial training demand (2019–2022, after 336-hour warmup). Generated from outputs/run_summary.json; never derived from test demand.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), FactForecast[ActualMW] >= [Training High Demand Threshold MW])), 0))
measures.Description: Scored test hours whose observed demand is at least the fixed training p90; zero for an empty subset. Retrospective diagnostic, not an advance alert.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), AVERAGEX(FILTER(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), FactForecast[ActualMW] >= [Training High Demand Threshold MW]), ABS(FactForecast[ForecastMW] - FactForecast[ActualMW])))
measures.Description: Mean absolute error during test hours above the fixed initial-training p90 actual-demand threshold.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), AVERAGEX(FILTER(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), FactForecast[ActualMW] >= [Training High Demand Threshold MW]), FactForecast[ForecastMW] - FactForecast[ActualMW]))
measures.Description: Forecast minus actual bias during high observed demand test hours. Negative indicates underforecasting.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), DIVIDE(COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(FILTER(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Lower80MW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Upper80MW])), FactForecast[ActualMW] >= [Training High Demand Threshold MW]), FactForecast[ActualMW] >= FactForecast[Lower80MW] && FactForecast[ActualMW] <= FactForecast[Upper80MW])), 0), COUNTROWS(FILTER(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Lower80MW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Upper80MW])), FactForecast[ActualMW] >= [Training High Demand Threshold MW]))))
measures.Description: Empirical coverage of nominal80% pointwise intervals during high observed-demand test hours. Requires valid actual, forecast and both bounds; blank when no valid high-demand intervals exist.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), CALCULATE(AVERAGE(FactForecast[ForecastMW]), KEEPFILTERS(FactForecast[Split] = "future")))
measures.Description: Historical next-day forecast from the end of the frozen 2025 source; not today's live forecast.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), CALCULATE(AVERAGE(FactForecast[Lower80MW]), KEEPFILTERS(FactForecast[Split] = "future")))
measures.Description: Pointwise lower 80% bound; displayed at hourly grain only.

measures.Expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), CALCULATE(AVERAGE(FactForecast[Upper80MW]), KEEPFILTERS(FactForecast[Split] = "future")))
measures.Description: Pointwise upper 80% bound; displayed at hourly grain only.
